name: reentrant_string
template: {%macro p(i)%}{%if i==2%}{%set ignored=123|string%}{%endif%}Y{%endmacro%}{%for i in [1,2] if p(i)%}{{loop|string}};{%endfor%}

name: reentrant_concat
template: {%macro p(i)%}{%if i==2%}{%set ignored=123|string%}{%endif%}Y{%endmacro%}{%for i in [1,2] if p(i)%}{{'A'~loop~'B'}};{%endfor%}

name: reentrant_join
template: {%macro p(i)%}{%if i==2%}{%set ignored=123|string%}{%endif%}Y{%endmacro%}{%for i in [1,2] if p(i)%}{{[loop,loop]|join('|')}};{%endfor%}

name: reentrant_nested_macros
